tail:
**Batch 40 is authored.** The 15 A-page items and four B-page examples are in [the A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-pdes-and-spatial-discretization/graph-diffusion-and-metric-network-pde-numerics.md) and [the examples page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/numerical-pdes-and-spatial-discretization/graph-diffusion-and-metric-network-pde-numerics-examples.md). The metric-graph proofs cover loops and parallel edges; the FEM rate remains conditional on edgewise H2 regularity, and the parabolic result claims no spatial rate.

All 19 items have Step 1 `ready` records. This is authoring readiness, not independent approval.

Checks passed: proof layout (19 items, 49 steps), proof contracts (15/15), coverage (28 harvested results), and batch-scoped dependency levels (19 items, maximum level 3). Source retrieval resolved 8/8 records: seven fetch stamps and one documented Kurasov URL drop with complete local alternatives. Source coverage includes [Chung](https://fanchung.ucsd.edu/cbms.pdf), [Kuchment](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0802.3442), and [Arioli–Benzi](https://www.cs.emory.edu/technical-reports/techrep-00275.pdf).

The full run remains open outside batch 40: the global dependency check reports 74 empty page inventories and 10 stale labels in other pairs, and batch-level recomputation encounters malformed YAML at [lem-ewald-gaussian-poisson-periodization.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-ewald-gaussian-poisson-periodization.md:21). I left those files untouched. The batch evidence and diagnostics are recorded in [the notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-40.notes.md), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-40.coverage.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-40.proof-contracts.json).
